NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE IS REQUIRED. ONLY ETERNAL CURIOSITY AND THE PLEASURE OF KNOWLEDGE. PLS KEEP UPDATED of any changes and updates on our WhatsApp Group: [Enjoy Philosophy Lisbon Group Access-Link](https://chat.whatsapp.com/EgaLvlLCAbSL00cYmhpOSu) We will learn, debate, enjoy and investigate philosophers and diverse themes from the philosophical perspective. Each reunion is structured as a conversation among all attendees about that day s philosopher softly moderated by the organizer. The conversation will kick-off from the very brief suggested reading providing easy access to all attendees both to the philosopher and the conversation. Let´s be greek and dive today on… **FREEDOM as a condition to live your own life upon your own terms, and therefore expect to be respected in your own choices, as well as respect your fellow women and men choices, as complicated as they may seem.** **And they are. Very often they are.** **If a dear friend tells you he is planning to jump from his window next wednesday at 17.30, and after every possible attempt to convince him to stay with us, you fail... can you force him not to... can you, should you forcibly prevent him from jumping ? Should you tell the police, drug him or tie him to his bed until he gives up ? Or you should just respect what he chose in full use of his conscience and maturity ? Does a person possesses full fledge sovereignty of his decisions over his own life ?** **Are there limits to my acceptance of other people´s existential choices ? We are entitled, of course, to try to convince others to change their minds, but if we fail, in extreme matters can you enforce, can you impose your will on them? Or should you therefore, ultimately, accept and respect their choice, as dramatic and incomprehensible as it might seem to you ?** **If my son decides his happiness is in injecting opium through his veins, and defends clearly, in full lucidity and consciousness of his decisions, his absolute right to decide how to live or die, how to spend his mornings under the sun of his time... Should I try to commit him ? Or, in spite of the pain and the sorrow, should I accept his full sovereignty over his own life ? If a person walks up one morning suddenly understanding that her happiness is helping the poor and the weak in Central Africa and therefore decides to leave everything, job, husband and 2 little children... to go and do what she must... should I accept the decision? If my little cousin decides to sell her body to make essentially 100 times in a month what she made cleaning... shoud I try everything to prevent it ? Can I force her not to ? Can I ? Should I ?** **Is the will upon your own life the last word anybody can utter on the issue ? Is your life only yours and, ultimately, as long as you don t commit a crime you are essentially legitimized to do anything you want with it.. And therefore noboby has any legitimacy to coercively prevent it ?** **Lets talk about freedom taken to its ultimate consequences... And respect... taken to its ultimate consequences...**

title: SPEAK & SIP: Language Exchange
description: This time our theme is **Love & Dating Across Cultures** — first dates, awkward moments, dating apps, and how relationships begin in different parts of the world. We’ll explore how cultural expectations shape dating, what people consider romantic (or embarrassing), and how modern technology has changed the way people meet. From funny misunderstandings to surprising cultural traditions, this theme offers plenty of room for humor, curiosity, and cultural comparison. It’s a great opportunity to exchange stories, reflect on different social norms, and practice speaking about relationships and social life in your target language. Our languages: English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, and German. At Speak & Sip, we do things a little differently. There’s structure — but the atmosphere is still relaxed. Think of it as semi-serious, semi-casual: fun and social, but with the clear purpose of improving our language skills. Here’s how it works: • **Each language has its own table** with a host or fluent speakers to guide the group. • **Native speakers** are always welcome to join their table and support learners. • For the **first hour**, we use conversation cards on the theme to keep things flowing. You’ll switch partners regularly so you can practice with different people. • The **second hour** is dedicated to games related to the theme — light, interactive, and designed to make everyone speak more. If you want something lighter, there will also be an **English chill table** where people can sit together and talk about any topic. But if your goal is to practice languages in a structured way, this is the right meetup for you. Our aim is simple: to connect through language, to learn from each other, and to make progress while enjoying good company. **[Join us on WhatsApp](https://chat.whatsapp.com/BWIfXe0dCFN7RMPt6NG7Mk)** **Follow the community: @forvm.lisbon** ATTENTION This is a **free event**, but you can buy me a coffee :) https://ko-fi.com/forvm

title: Open Coffee Lisbon Evening Social
description: Join us for the **Open Coffee Lisbon Evening Social**—a relaxed, welcoming gathering designed for anyone in Lisbon’s vibrant startup and professional community who wants to connect beyond the usual business talk. Hosted by Richard Lucas and the friendly Open Coffee Lisbon team, this event is all about genuine conversations, new friendships, and building a supportive network in a laid-back atmosphere. Many of our current event participants head out for lunch to hang out after our sell out morning meetings. We decided to offer a more social event in fabulous setting. Whether you’re an entrepreneur, student, creative, tourist, or simply curious, you’ll find a space where everyone is encouraged to mingle, share stories, and discover common interests. Our events are open and welcoming to people from all backgrounds and ages. Many different nationalities come together at our events, as well as long term Lisbon residents. Our motto "we welcome all, who welcome all." **This is not a speed dating/pickup type event. Everyone who attends is entitled to feel safe, not be harassed or pressured.** **EVENT STRUCTURE:** We will have a structured first sixty minutes with icebreakers aimed at making things easy for people to connect with one another. Then participants are welcome to hang out and socialise as they wish after the structured part of the meeting is over. **REACH OUT:** If you have a community initiative you want to share or announce, let us know in advance. **VOLUNTEERS** We need volunteers to help us develop the project. From simple things like being early to welcome people, through to PR and graphic design and a website. Let us know if that sounds like you and apply to join the team [here](https://forms.gle/EeLboZcYBrLesVt26) Newcomers are especially welcome, and if you’re feeling shy, don't worry. you’re free to listen or join in at your own pace. Bring your ideas, your curiosity, and your favourite conversation starters. Share your LinkedIn or project links with the group, and let’s help each other grow—personally and professionally. This evening is about making connections that matter, all in a friendly, inclusive setting. If you’d like to help shape future gatherings or feature in our community newsletter, let us know. Come for the connections, stay for the camaraderie! Please let us know if you can volunteer and help [here](https://forms.gle/EeLboZcYBrLesVt26) **Please note that the evening entrance is from the sea front.** **[This link](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4aNCJLp9JXRqCsUC6) has a map to find your way from the Metro.** **[this video](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/qoLE8jp2i1g) show how to find your way from the Metro.** if you are at the "City" side entrance of Titanic [here](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tEb6MmBNxoaBZhcHA) , and can't figure out how to get in, check [this video ](https://youtube.com/shorts/gq0QQ_RnNbQ?si=rKthOudD36TIS5GB)It's only 8 seconds long. The correct pin for the entrance is [here](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zjkfu5hVCeEV5miH8)
